text: After this you can interpret heat-pump and refrigeration measurements without confusing heat transfer with electricity input.

A refrigeration cycle moves heat between locations using compressor work and other equipment. Cooling capacity is the rate of heat removed. Coefficient of performance (COP) is useful cooling or heating output divided by input energy on a matching basis. Moisture removal is a latent load; changing air temperature is a sensible load. Both can matter in comfort and process settings. Verify temperatures, flow, humidity, part-load conditions, and controls before judging savings.
